summary: Enhance your project evaluation skills with our Cost-Benefit Analysis training course. Learn to assess project viability effectively and make informed decisions
lede: Cost-benefit analysis compares project costs with financial, social, and other benefits to inform investment decisions. This training is for professionals who evaluate, manage, or approve projects, and develops skills in identifying direct and indirect costs, assessing options with measures such as net present value and cost-effectiveness, and examining uncertainty and non-monetary impacts.
